name: Natural Plan Meeting Planning
description: Write a solve(question, llm) program that uses a budgeted OpenRouter LLM client to answer Natural Plan meeting-planning prompts (meet as many San Francisco friends as possible under availability and travel-time constraints); scored by success rate on a fixed 30-problem test sample, a plan succeeding when its simulated valid meetings match the golden plan's count (higher is better).

sources.locator: Section 4.3, Table 2, Appendix A.2 and Appendix B
1,000 problems; test split = last 50 per number of people

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

evaluation.source_locator: Section 4.3, Table 2, Appendix A.2 and Appendix B

notes: Calendar Scheduling is explicitly excluded by the paper.

limitations: No official runnable repository was verified from the paper/project sources examined.
Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.
No publicly accessible, paper-linked implementation with a verified immutable revision was established.
